verdict.rationale: monday.com documents handing work to agents by assigning items and @mentioning them in updates, with replies, statuses and follow-ups kept on the item. It also keeps a single agent identity across Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Make, MCP and the API, and offers 2-way sync with external platforms, so work and its record stay attached to the board item. However, no evidence explicitly shows context or state preserved when work passes from one tool or agent to another. A community report that ticket-linking data 'gets lost' concerns ticket links, not agent handoff, so it lowers confidence but does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented context/state transfer between agents or tools, explicit guarantees against information loss on handoff, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information

citations.quote: Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.
Bring an agent in once and reach it from Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Make, our MCP, or the API. One identity, every surface — no rebuilding per channel.
Enable 2-way sync between monday products and any platform you work with to trigger automations, eliminate manual work, and keep your business in motion.
